name: @portaless/apw-resolver
description: Standalone client/resolver for Protocol APW: resolve did:apw identities, verify site manifests (DNS TXT), chained history, and JWS signatures. Zero Portaless dependencies — only Web APIs + canonicalize (JCS).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/standalone.ts src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --external:canonicalize --outdir=dist && esbuild conformance/cli.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --external:canonicalize --outfile=dist/conformance/cli.js
